# STH compatibility matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-reference.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Schema `1`, STH CLI `dev`.

This file is a snapshot for offline reading. `capabilities_get` is
authoritative: it reports the matrix of the CLI actually deployed for the
caller's organization, which may be ahead of this copy.

## Levels

| Level | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exact` | converts with no loss | Convert. State the destination path. |
| `lossy` | converts, something is dropped | Convert **and name what is lost**, before writing anything. |
| `native-only` | exists only in that tool's own native format | Do not synthesise an equivalent. Explain. |
| `unsupported` | no conversion path | Say so. Do not improvise a lookalike. |
